scope: Isolated React handler tests with a test editor host, actual production Worker on Node transport, and software serial-port fixture. Not Chrome DOM or physical USB tests.

checks.name: Autocomplete is optional, persists locally, and removes its extension when disabled
Autosave writes current source without pressing Save; default theme is light
Local save restores exact source after remount
Export .ino contains the current source
Import .ino updates the editor with actual file contents
Compile handler uses current imported code through the real Worker
System Check uses real WASM but cannot replace the active sketch or its upload artifact
Font size and layout controls preserve source and record only local session statistics
Compiler line-number diagnostics remain visible after real GCC failure
Upload handler recompiles changed source and calls unchanged STK500v1 with readback
Serial line endings and numeric plotter handle real stream chunks
Paused monitor freezes display while the port drains and the plotter keeps receiving real samples
Plot pause keeps Serial Monitor reading, resume adds multiple series, CSV exports real samples, and Clear empties the chart
Monitor closes and releases its port before firmware upload
Serial Monitor receives text, sends newline-terminated text, and disconnects
Physical-disconnect event clears selected-port state immediately
Theme persists; duplicate preserves source; rename is saved locally
School-policy rejection produces clear IT guidance
Library checkmarks agree with exact-build compile/link evidence
Library search finds OLED by description and examples
Two simultaneous tabs compile their exact source into different real HEX; late results stay with the initiating sketch
Each tab uploads only its own real HEX through unchanged STK500v1 and readback verification (software port fixture)
Switching sketches while USB selection is pending cancels before any flash commands
All sketches, open tabs, tab order, and active sketch survive remount from IndexedDB
Export All downloads ZIP with current sketches; sketch content is stored only in IndexedDB
Closing a tab keeps its saved sketch and reopening restores its exact code
Delete requires confirmation; Cancel keeps data and confirmation removes only that sketch
Save/New/Close handlers and Alt fallbacks work when the browser delivers the keyboard event
Examples reject incorrect/case/space variants, cancel preserves work, and exact password opens a new sketch
Public example opens once as a new sketch; navigation waits for the real WASM compile to finish
Leaving the IDE commits pending local edits and releases the Serial Monitor port before navigation
Project UI compiles separate C++ objects; switching files retains firmware and secondary-file edits force genuine recompilation before upload
Project records, selected file, independent source contents and open tabs survive IndexedDB remount; project ZIP downloads
Optional Test My Uno requires explicit actions, uses real WASM + unchanged STK500v1, rejects bad readback, and never replaces student sketches or their firmware (software port only)
ATmega328PB — 16 MHz: UI compiles its own board macro and current source; actual baud reaches uploader; flash readback and Serial Monitor reopen pass (software port)
Arduino Nano V3 — ATmega328P (new bootloader): UI compiles its own board macro and current source; actual baud reaches uploader; flash readback and Serial Monitor reopen pass (software port)
Arduino Nano V3 — ATmega328P (old bootloader): UI compiles its own board macro and current source; actual baud reaches uploader; flash readback and Serial Monitor reopen pass (software port)
Nano selection survives remount without modifying IndexedDB sketches or project records
Target selector is locked during pending USB selection and cannot retarget an in-flight upload
Switching back to Uno restores original compilation behavior and clears a Nano device selection
